text:
Which statement about rusting is not correct?
A
Only oxygen is needed for rusting.
B
Painting can stop iron gates rusting.
Rust is hydrated iron(III) oxide.
C
D
Water and oxygen are both needed for rusting.

options.label: A
options.text: Only oxygen is needed for rusting.

options.label: B
options.text: Painting can stop iron gates rusting.

options.label: D
options.text: Water and oxygen are both needed for rusting.
